text.description_html:
Exit Device Pull Plate

This Pull Plate Trim for Global Door Controls ED-501-DU Dark Bronze Exit Device, ED-VR531-DU Dark Bronze Vertical Rod Exit Device and other manufactures Panic Devices. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Used to cover a pre drilled bore hole. This pull plate is used when installing a Panic Device on doors with pre drilled bore holes. where an exterior door pull is desired for entry if the panic device is dogged. Can also be used on Non pre drilled doors.

Specifications for Global ED-PP06501-DU Pull Plate

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Dark Bronze
  • Pull Plate Height: 7-3/8"
  • Pull Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Pull Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Mounting Holes: 1/4" Square, 3-1/2" Center to Center, 5/8" Offset from Plate Center Line
  • Includes Carriage Bolts with Nuts for Mounting
